sources.title: Usman Imam: Kawashima Midori’s lecture commentary · Sophia record 2005239
sources.author: Kawashima Midori · section II.1, 講師ウスマン氏について
sources.description: Names Usman Imam’s father Tabunawan, a mosque imam, and his unnamed mother from Bayang. The sixth-generation descendant is Tabunawan. Source uses Magonana; the equation with Magonaya needs checking. Local summary and short excerpts are preserved; the original PDF could not be downloaded during repository maintenance.
sources.discoveryNote: Found November 9, 2026 through the built-in web research search tool using: site:sophia.repo.nii.ac.jp Tabunawan. The result returned a Sophia PDF URL and indexed Japanese text. These notes preserve excerpts and a working translation, not the original PDF; verification against the PDF is pending. Japanese search term: タブナワン.
sources.backupDescription: Backup contains saved research notes, short excerpts, and discovery steps. The original Sophia PDF has not been downloaded; verification against it is pending.
sources.credit: Kawashima Midori (commentary); Usman Imam Sheik Al-Aman; Mitsuko Saito (translation). Journal of Sophia Asian Studies 22 (2004), pp. 173–195. Original publication and repository: Sophia University.
